verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ὄχλου πάλιν ὄντος πολλοῦ καὶ ἐχόντων μὴ τί φάγωσιν προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς λέγει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: En ekeinais tais hēmerais ochlou palin ontos pollou kai echontōn mē ti phagōsin proskalesamenos tous mathētas legei autois
verses.literal: In those - days [the] crowd once again became very large and they had nothing vvv to eat [Jesus] called the disciples {to Him} [and] said -

verses.original: Σπλαγχνίζομαι ἐπὶ τὸν ὄχλον ὅτι προσμένουσίν ἤδη μοι τρεῖς ἡμέραι καὶ ἔχουσιν οὐκ τί φάγωσιν
verses.transliteration: Splanchnizomai epi ton ochlon hoti prosmenousin ēdē moi treis hēmerai kai echousin ouk ti phagōsin
verses.literal: I have compassion for [this] crowd because they have already been . . . with Me three days and have nothing vvv to eat

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἀπολύσω αὐτοὺς εἰς αὐτῶν οἶκον νήστεις ἐκλυθήσονται ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καί τινες αὐτῶν ἥκασιν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν
verses.transliteration: kai ean apolysō autous eis autōn oikon nēsteis eklythēsontai en tē hodō kai tines autōn hēkasin apo makrothen
verses.literal: - If I send them vvv vvv home hungry they will faint along the way For some of them have come vvv a great distance

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πόθεν ἐπ’ ἐρημίας ὧδε δυνήσεταί τις ἄρτων χορτάσαι τούτους
verses.transliteration: Kai autou hoi mathētai apekrithēsan autō hoti Pothen ep’ erēmias hōde dynēsetai tis artōn chortasai toutous
verses.literal: - His - disciples replied - - Where in this desolate place . . . could anyone [find enough] bread to feed all these [people]

verses.original: Πόσους ἄρτους ἔχετε Καὶ ἠρώτα αὐτούς Ἑπτά δὲ Οἱ εἶπαν
verses.transliteration: Posous artous echete Kai ērōta autous Hepta de Hoi eipan
verses.literal: How many loaves do you have - [Jesus] asked - Seven - - they replied

verses.original: Καὶ παραγγέλλει τῷ ὄχλῳ ἀναπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ λαβὼν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἄρτους εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς αὐτοῦ μαθηταῖς ἵνα παρατιθῶσιν καὶ παρέθηκαν τῷ ὄχλῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai parangellei tō ochlō anapesein epi tēs gēs kai labōn tous hepta artous eucharistēsas eklasen kai edidou tois autou mathētais hina paratithōsin kai parethēkan tō ochlō
verses.literal: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground Then He took the seven loaves gave thanks [and] broke [them] and gave [them] to His disciples - to set before [the people] And they distributed [them] to the crowd

verses.original: εἶχον καὶ ὀλίγα ἰχθύδια καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτὰ εἶπεν ταῦτα παρατιθέναι καὶ
verses.transliteration: eichon kai oliga ichthydia kai eulogēsas auta eipen tauta paratithenai kai
verses.literal: They also had . . . a few small fish and [Jesus] blessed them [and] ordered that these be set before [them] as well

verses.original: Καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν καὶ ἦραν ἑπτὰ σπυρίδας κλασμάτων περισσεύματα
verses.transliteration: Kai ephagon kai echortasthēsan kai ēran hepta spyridas klasmatōn perisseumata
verses.literal: - [The people] ate and were satisfied and [the disciples] picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over

verses.original: δὲ ὡς τετρακισχίλιοι ἦσαν καὶ ἀπέλυσεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de hōs tetrakischilioi ēsan kai apelysen autous
verses.literal: And about four thousand [men] were [ present ] And when [Jesus] had dismissed [the crowd]

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐμβὰς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον μετὰ αὐτοῦ τῶν μαθητῶν ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ μέρη Δαλμανουθά
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys embas eis to ploion meta autou tōn mathētōn ēlthen eis ta merē Dalmanoutha
verses.literal: - He immediately got into the boat with His - disciples [and] went to the district of Dalmanutha

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν αὐτῷ πειράζοντες αὐτόν ζητοῦντες παρ’ αὐτοῦ σημεῖον ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi Pharisaioi exēlthon kai ērxanto syzētein autō peirazontes auton zētountes par’ autou sēmeion apo tou ouranou
verses.literal: Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with [Jesus] testing Him [by] demanding from Him a sign from - heaven

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστενάξας τῷ αὐτοῦ πνεύματι λέγει Τί αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ ζητεῖ σημεῖον ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν εἰ σημεῖον δοθήσεται ταύτῃ τῇ γενεᾷ
verses.transliteration: Kai anastenaxas tō autou pneumati legei Ti hautē hē genea zētei sēmeion amēn legō hymin ei sēmeion dothēsetai tautē tē genea
verses.literal: - [Jesus] sighed deeply in His spirit [and] said Why {does} this - generation demand a sign Truly I tell you no sign will be given to this - generation

verses.original: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς ἐμβὰς πάλιν ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸ πέραν
verses.transliteration: kai apheis autous embas palin apēlthen eis to peran
verses.literal: And He left them got back into the boat . . . [and] crossed to the other side

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπελάθοντο λαβεῖν ἄρτους καὶ εἰ μὴ ἕνα ἄρτον οὐκ εἶχον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai epelathonto labein artous kai ei mē hena arton ouk eichon meth’ heautōn en tō ploiō
verses.literal: Now [the disciples] had forgotten to take bread - except for . . . one loaf - they had with them in the boat

verses.original: Ὁρᾶτε καὶ διεστέλλετο αὐτοῖς λέγων βλέπετε ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ τῆς ζύμης Ἡρῴδου
verses.transliteration: Horate kai diestelleto autois legōn blepete apo tēs zymēs tōn Pharisaiōn kai tēs zymēs Hērōdou
verses.literal: Watch out - He cautioned them - Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and - - of Herod

verses.original: καὶ διελογίζοντο πρὸς ἀλλήλους ὅτι ἔχουσιν οὐκ ἄρτους
verses.transliteration: kai dielogizonto pros allēlous hoti echousin ouk artous
verses.literal: [So] they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread

verses.original: Καὶ γνοὺς λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί διαλογίζεσθε ὅτι ἔχετε οὐκ ἄρτους οὔπω νοεῖτε οὐδὲ συνίετε ἔχετε ὑμῶν πεπωρωμένην τὴν καρδίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai gnous legei autois Ti dialogizesthe hoti echete ouk artous oupō noeite oude syniete echete hymōn pepōrōmenēn tēn kardian
verses.literal: vvv Aware of [their conversation] [Jesus] asked them Why are you debating about having no bread vvv Do you still not see or understand Do you have . . . such hard - hearts

verses.original: ἔχοντες Ὀφθαλμοὺς οὐ βλέπετε καὶ ἔχοντες ὦτα οὐκ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐ μνημονεύετε
verses.transliteration: echontes Ophthalmous ou blepete kai echontes ōta ouk akouete kai ou mnēmoneuete
verses.literal: Having eyes vvv do you not see And having ears vvv do you not hear And vvv do you not remember

verses.original: ὅτε ἔκλασα τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους εἰς τοὺς πεντακισχιλίους πόσους κοφίνους πλήρεις κλασμάτων ἤρατε Δώδεκα Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hote eklasa tous pente artous eis tous pentakischilious posous kophinous plēreis klasmatōn ērate Dōdeka Legousin autō
verses.literal: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand how many basketfuls . . . of broken pieces did you collect Twelve they answered -

verses.original: καὶ Ὅτε τοὺς ἑπτὰ εἰς τοὺς τετρακισχιλίους πόσων σπυρίδων πληρώματα κλασμάτων ἤρατε Ἑπτά Καὶ αὐτῷ λέγουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai Hote tous hepta eis tous tetrakischilious posōn spyridōn plērōmata klasmatōn ērate Hepta Kai autō legousin
verses.literal: And when [I broke] the seven [loaves] for the four thousand how many basketfuls . . . of broken pieces did you collect Seven - they said

verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Οὔπω συνίετε
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois Oupō syniete
verses.literal: Then He asked them vvv Do you still not understand

verses.original: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Βηθσαϊδάν Καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτῷ τυφλὸν καὶ παρακαλοῦσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα ἅψηται αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai erchontai eis Bēthsaidan Kai pherousin autō typhlon kai parakalousin auton hina hapsētai autou
verses.literal: [When] they arrived at Bethsaida - [some people] brought - a blind [man] and begged [Jesus] to touch him

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιλαβόμενος τοῦ τυφλοῦ τῆς χειρὸς ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς κώμης καὶ πτύσας εἰς αὐτοῦ τὰ ὄμματα ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῷ Εἴ βλέπεις τι ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai epilabomenos tou typhlou tēs cheiros exēnenken auton exō tēs kōmēs kai ptysas eis autou ta ommata epitheis tas cheiras autō Ei blepeis ti epērōta auton
verses.literal: So He took the blind [man] by the hand [and] led him - out of the village Then He spit on [the man’s] - eyes [and] placed [His] hands on him vvv Can you see anything He asked -

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναβλέψας ἔλεγεν Βλέπω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ὅτι ὁρῶ ὡς δένδρα περιπατοῦντας
verses.transliteration: Kai anablepsas elegen Blepō tous anthrōpous hoti horō hōs dendra peripatountas
verses.literal: - [The man] looked up [and] said I can see the people [but] they look like trees walking around

verses.original: Εἶτα πάλιν ἐπέθηκεν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ διέβλεψεν καὶ ἀπεκατέστη καὶ ἐνέβλεπεν ἅπαντα τηλαυγῶς
verses.transliteration: Eita palin epethēken tas cheiras epi autou tous ophthalmous kai dieblepsen kai apekatestē kai eneblepen hapanta tēlaugōs
verses.literal: Once again . . . [Jesus] placed [His] hands on [the man’s] - eyes and when he opened them - [his sight] was restored and he could see everything clearly

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εἰς αὐτοῦ οἶκον λέγων Μηδὲ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς τὴν κώμην
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen auton eis autou oikon legōn Mēde eiselthēs eis tēn kōmēn
verses.literal: - [Jesus] sent him vvv vvv home [and] said vvv Do not go back into the village

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὰς κώμας Καισαρείας τῆς Φιλίππου καὶ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐπηρώτα αὐτοῦ τοὺς μαθητὰς λέγων αὐτοῖς Τίνα οἱ ἄνθρωποι λέγουσιν με εἶναι
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous kai autou hoi mathētai exēlthen eis tas kōmas Kaisareias tēs Philippou kai en tē hodō epērōta autou tous mathētas legōn autois Tina hoi anthrōpoi legousin me einai
verses.literal: Then - Jesus and His - disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea - Philippi - On the way He questioned His - disciples - - Who - {do} people say I am

verses.original: εἶπαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι Ἰωάννην τὸν Βαπτιστήν δὲ Οἱ καὶ ἄλλοι Ἠλίαν δὲ ἄλλοι ὅτι εἷς τῶν προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: eipan autō legontes hoti Iōannēn ton Baptistēn de Hoi kai alloi Ēlian de alloi hoti heis tōn prophētōn
verses.literal: They replied . . . . . . - [Some say] John the Baptist - - - others [say] Elijah and still others - one of the prophets

verses.original: δὲ Ὑμεῖς Καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς τίνα λέγετε με εἶναι ὁ Πέτρος Ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: de Hymeis Kai autos epērōta autous tina legete me einai ho Petros Apokritheis legei autō Sy ei ho Christos
verses.literal: But [what about] you - [Jesus] asked - Who do you say I am - Peter answered - - You are the Christ

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα λέγωσιν μηδενὶ περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai epetimēsen autois hina legōsin mēdeni peri autou
verses.literal: And [Jesus] warned them - not to tell anyone . . . about Him

verses.original: Καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς ὅτι τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου δεῖ παθεῖν πολλὰ καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ὑπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ τῶν γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστῆναι
verses.transliteration: Kai ērxato didaskein autous hoti ton Huion tou anthrōpou dei pathein polla kai apodokimasthēnai hypo tōn presbyterōn kai tōn archiereōn kai tōn grammateōn kai apoktanthēnai kai meta treis hēmeras anastēnai
verses.literal: Then He began to teach them that the Son - of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders - - chief priests and - scribes and [that] He must be killed and after three days rise [again]

verses.original: καὶ ἐλάλει τὸν λόγον παρρησίᾳ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος προσλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἤρξατο ἐπιτιμᾶν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai elalei ton logon parrēsia kai ho Petros proslabomenos auton ērxato epitiman autō
verses.literal: - He spoke [this] message quite frankly and - Peter took Him aside . . . [and] began to rebuke Him

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐπιστραφεὶς καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτοῦ τοὺς μαθητὰς ἐπετίμησεν Πέτρῳ καὶ λέγει Ὕπαγε ὀπίσω μου Σατανᾶ ὅτι οὐ φρονεῖς τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Ho de epistrapheis kai idōn autou tous mathētas epetimēsen Petrō kai legei Hypage opisō mou Satana hoti ou phroneis ta tou Theou alla ta tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: - But [Jesus] turning and looking at His - disciples rebuked Peter and said Get behind Me Satan For vvv you do not have in mind the things of God but the things of men

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν ὄχλον σὺν αὐτοῦ τοῖς μαθηταῖς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Εἴ τις θέλει ἐλθεῖν ὀπίσω μου ἀπαρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω αὐτοῦ τὸν σταυρὸν καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos ton ochlon syn autou tois mathētais eipen autois Ei tis thelei elthein opisō mou aparnēsasthō heauton kai aratō autou ton stauron kai akoloutheitō moi
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] called the crowd {to Him} along with His - disciples [and] He told them If anyone wants to come after Me he must deny himself and take up his - cross and follow Me

verses.original: γὰρ ὃς ἐὰν θέλῃ σῶσαι τὴν αὐτοῦ ψυχὴν ἀπολέσει αὐτήν δ’ ὃς ἂν ἀπολέσει αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου σώσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: gar hos ean thelē sōsai tēn autou psychēn apolesei autēn d’ hos an apolesei autou tēn psychēn heneken emou kai tou euangeliou sōsei autēn
verses.literal: For whoever vvv wants to save - his life will lose it but whoever . . . loses his - life for My sake . . . and for the gospel will save it

verses.original: γὰρ Τί ὠφελεῖ ἄνθρωπον κερδῆσαι τὸν ὅλον κόσμον καὶ ζημιωθῆναι αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν
verses.transliteration: gar Ti ōphelei anthrōpon kerdēsai ton holon kosmon kai zēmiōthēnai autou tēn psychēn
verses.literal: - What does it profit a man to gain the whole world yet forfeit his - soul

verses.original: γὰρ τί ἄνθρωπος δοῖ ἀντάλλαγμα τῆς αὐτοῦ ψυχῆς
verses.transliteration: gar ti anthrōpos doi antallagma tēs autou psychēs
verses.literal: Or what {can} a man give in exchange for his soul

verses.original: γὰρ ὃς ἐὰν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ ἐμοὺς τοὺς λόγους ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ μοιχαλίδι καὶ ἁμαρτωλῷ τῇ γενεᾷ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἐπαισχυνθήσεται αὐτὸν ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν αὐτοῦ τοῦ Πατρὸς τῇ δόξῃ μετὰ τῶν τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: gar hos ean epaischynthē me kai emous tous logous en tautē tē moichalidi kai hamartōlō tē genea ho Huios tou anthrōpou kai epaischynthēsetai auton hotan elthē en autou tou Patros tē doxē meta tōn tōn hagiōn angelōn
verses.literal: - If anyone vvv is ashamed of Me and My - words in this - adulterous and sinful - generation the Son - of Man vvv will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His - Father’s - glory with the - holy angels
